name: sprutmonitor
description: Read-only SprutMonitor DLP Cloud (sprutmonitor.ru) MCP: risks, idle time, productivity, and employee monitoring. Runs locally; demo or your console login.

SPRUT_API_BASE.title: API base URL
SPRUT_API_BASE.description: Cloud API host (serverBase). Leave default for public cloud.

SPRUT_EMAIL.title: Console email
SPRUT_EMAIL.description: Operator email. Demo default works for try-out; use your least-privilege operator for a real tenant.

SPRUT_PASSWORD.title: Console password
SPRUT_PASSWORD.description: Operator password. Demo default is "demo". Never commit production passwords.
